usedFor: Formo collects form answers, and “New Submission” starts your next step when a form is submitted.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Formo, then “Create Customer” in Veeqo
bestTemplate.why: Each submission carries the form answers, so the action can create a customer from them.

watchOut: “New Submission” is polling, so the next step runs after a scheduled check, not the moment a form is sent.
